title: dendrobium bicornutum
intro: Dendrobium bicornutum, commonly known as the two-horned orchid, is an orchid species native to China, used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Dendrobium bicornutum include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and neuroprotective properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
